name: desktop-aquarium
description: An interactive, energy-aware aquarium wallpaper for macOS, powered by Three.js and WebGL2.

scripts.check: node --check serve.mjs && for f in scenes/*/src/*.js scenes/shared/*.js ui/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: node ui/tests/gallery.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/fish-behavior.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/render-policy.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/plant-budget.mjs && node scenes/reefscape/tests/behavior.mjs && node scenes/reefscape/tests/assets.mjs && node scenes/reefscape/tests/locomotion.mjs && node scenes/reefscape/tests/anemone.mjs
